name: Crash Assistant Vulkan GPU Detection Addon
description: Provides Vulkan libraries in a jar-in-jar format for cross-platform GPU detection with their types. Enables warnings when playing on an integrated GPU while a dedicated GPU is available. While the main Crash Assistant mod includes lightweight DirectX-based detection for modern Windows only, this addon adds support for very old Windows versions and Linux/MacOS platforms. This addon has no standalone functionality - it simply provides Vulkan libraries for the Crash Assistant mod.
